meta.title: WP Lab — CI blueprint
meta.author: shzakx-ai
meta.description: Boots WordPress, activates the mounted lab-theme, asserts the active stylesheet, and creates a test page.

steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $t = wp_get_theme(); $stylesheet = get_stylesheet(); echo 'WP_LAB_THEME=' . $t->get('Name') . '|STYLESHEET=' . $stylesheet; if ($stylesheet !== 'lab-theme') { throw new Exception('lab-theme is not the active stylesheet, got: ' . $stylesheet); }
